summary: Iteration 19 — verified 6 shipped changes (passport tickets, notifications bell, VIP removal, corporate skyscrapers image, email 'dès 11H' cleanup, StaffNewBooking special_events). Backend pytest: 10/11 PASS. 1 FAIL is a real backend bug — POST /api/staff/bookings with offer_type='special_event' returns 400 because server.py:7335 passes `event_id` to BookingCreate(...) which expects `special_event_id`. Pydantic silently drops the unknown field. Frontend smoke 4/4 PASS.

critical.issue: Field name mismatch — server.py:7333-7346 builds BookingCreate(event_id=body.event_id, ...) but BookingCreate (server.py:419) declares `special_event_id`. Pydantic v2 silently ignores the extra `event_id` so the call falls through to validator at server.py:2022 which raises 400 'special_event_id is required for special_event bookings'. Result: the staff /staff/nouvelle-resa flow can never submit a special_event booking even though the new card UI exposes it. Fix: change line 7335 to `special_event_id=body.event_id`.

rca of the issue: Bug: POST /api/staff/bookings with offer_type='special_event' + event_id=<id> returns 400 'special_event_id is required for special_event bookings'. Reproduction: login as admin, POST /api/staff/bookings {offer_type:'special_event', event_id:'<valid_event>', date:'<event_date>', boat_time:'08H45', adults:1, children:0, participants:[<booker>], payment_method:'cash'} → 400. RCA: server.py StaffBookingCreate model (line 7311) names the field `event_id`. server.py line 7333-7346 builds BookingCreate(event_id=body.event_id, ...) but BookingCreate (line 419) names it `special_event_id`. Pydantic v2 default config silently drops unknown kwargs, so `special_event_id` ends up None and the validator at line 2022 raises 400. Mitigation: change server.py:7335 from `event_id=body.event_id,` to `special_event_id=body.event_id,`. One-line fix.
